81853: Decim is the bartender of Quindecim and also the arbiter of floor 15. His faction deals with people who have died at the same time. He can create threads and use them to restrict rude customers from moving, or use them to hang things.
82037: She is an amnesiac woman taken in by Nona to Quindecim and hired as Decim's assistant. When she first awoke, she appeared to be an innocent but skeptical woman.
